context: Wraps two existing async controller actions in Task.Run, described in the PR as an optimization for slow requests.
explanation: Task.Run offloads work to a thread-pool thread, but GetByIdAsync and RenderPdfAsync are already asynchronous I/O calls with no CPU-bound work to offload. Wrapping them in Task.Run inside an ASP.NET Core request just queues an extra thread-pool work item per request, burning a thread pool slot and adding scheduling overhead for zero benefit. Under load this makes thread pool starvation more likely, not less. Fix: await the async calls directly; only use Task.Run to move genuinely CPU-bound work off the request thread.
